description: This file defines the SupportsAtomicPartitionManagement interface, which provides methods for atomic management of table partitions, including creation, dropping, purging, and truncating partitions, with support for rollback and exception handling.

classes.name: SupportsAtomicPartitionManagement
classes.description: An interface for atomic management of table partitions, extending SupportsPartitionManagement, with methods for creating, dropping, purging, and truncating partitions atomically.

methods.name: createPartition
methods.description: Creates a single partition atomically, wrapping createPartitions and handling PartitionsAlreadyExistException.

methods.name: dropPartition
methods.description: Drops a single partition by calling dropPartitions with a single-element array.

methods.name: createPartitions
methods.description: Abstract method to create multiple partitions atomically; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: dropPartitions
methods.description: Abstract method to drop multiple partitions atomically; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: purgePartitions
methods.description: Default method to purge partitions; throws unsupported error by default.

methods.name: truncatePartitions
methods.description: Default method to truncate partitions; throws unsupported error by default.
